name: MOL Charitable Trust call for proposals
summary: Call for proposals from a Mauritius-based charitable trust funding non-profit-run projects that restore and protect the natural environment and support local communities, focused on the southeast of the island but open island-wide.

amount.note: Up to 1 million rupees per year per selected project

status.quote: has made its fifth call for proposals with a deadline of Friday, September 29, 2025.

deadline.quote: has made its fifth call for proposals with a deadline of Friday, September 29, 2025.

applicant_types.quote: NPOs operating the grant recipient projects will be obliged to contribute to the restoration and protection of the natural environment

geography.quote: projects throughout the island are also eligible for funding, while the main focus is on projects in the southeastern part of the island.

access.quote: has made its fifth call for proposals

window.quote: Since its establishment, the Trust has made four calls for projects
